name: Old School Hash Co. Temple Ball | Grape Gas
description:
Embark on a spiritual journey with our temple ball hash, crafted in homage to centuries-old techniques. Each temple ball is meticulously rolled by hand, offering a harmonious blend of flavors and aromas that evoke a sense of reverence and tranquility.

Crafted with precision and designed with sophistication, each Pack is a compact 3 x 2-inch tin that encapsulates an unparalleled combination of quality hash and a sleek one-hitter pipe.
